snippet.title: He Knows Everyone — But They’ve Never Met Him #TimeLoop #MovieScenes
snippet.description:
In the J Squad scene from Edge of Tomorrow (2014), Cage calls the soldiers by name. They have never met him, but he has already lived this day.
